summary.text: Letishia Silva is the Democratic candidate for Idaho State Senate District 13 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Her career experience includes work as a managing partner and an executive office administrator.

paragraphs.text: Letishia Silva was born in Pocatello, Idaho, and earned a high school diploma from Cascade Jr./Sr. High School.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she listed her campaign messages as "Idaho Families First," local solutions and accountable government, and "Principles Over Party."
She named families and affordability, accountability and good government, and freedom and equal rights as the policy areas she cares most about.
